overview.description: The REX-Osprey XRP ETF (XRPR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the price of XRP. The fund holds assets designed to track XRPs spot value, offering a way to gain price exposure without directly holding the cryptocurrency. XRPR was launched on Sep 18, 2025 and is issued by REX-Osprey.
